caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chest or trunk with four legs, rendered in shades of brown. The chest features a rectangular front and sides, with the front panel containing a raised triangular decorative element at its center. The edges of the chest are defined with darker outlines, emphasizing its depth and dimensions. The bottom edge of the front panel displays a series of evenly spaced, downward-pointing arches as decorative cutouts. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color. The artist's signature and location, "MAJEL G. CLAFIN - TAOS N.M.," appear in the lower right corner.
title: Chest
